title: Système
description: Live overview of this computer: CPU usage, memory usage and CPU temperature (with warning/critical thresholds), operating system (name, kernel/build, architecture, host name, user, boot time, uptime, process count), CPU model, cores, threads and frequency, memory and swap details, the 15 most active processes (CPU %, memory), and temperature sensors when the OS exposes them.

functions.name: get_processes
functions.description: Running processes of this computer, sorted and filtered: name, PID, parent PID, CPU %, memory (MiB), user, start time, executable path and command line (obvious secrets such as --password=… are masked). Use it to find what slows the computer down or to check a process; the overview get_system only lists the 15 most active.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order: cpu (most active first), memory (largest first) or name.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keep only processes whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
